title: Signal: Python requirement pinned with a wildcard
scope: A requirements.txt file that declares an `==N.*` wildcard pin, which accepts every release in that segment.
limitations: It matches an `==N.*` wildcard pin, which accepts every release in that segment in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A requirements.txt that mentions an `==N.*` wildcard pin, which accepts every release in that segment in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
